title: bootstrap-priv-vpc-iam-roles-and-policy-module
creator: Aisha Rao
description: Create a reusable Terraform module to bootstrap IAM/RBAC for Private (VPC) Redwood deployments. The module should produce least-privilege roles, role bindings, and optional resource policies needed for on-prem and VPC installs. Scope: - core infra roles for runtime, autoscaler, and observability agents - service accounts/roles for customer-managed KMS integration - cross-account role assumption for Dedicated control plane access - outputs and maps to be consumed by private deployment templates - built-in tests, tfsec checks, and an upgrade compatibility guide. Must support both AWS and GCP primitives via a small provider abstraction layer (variables to switch provider behavior). Module must be opinionated but parameterizable to avoid one-off customer patches.
acceptance_criteria: Module published to our internal registry (registry.redwood.local) and referenced by private-deploy example manifest
Generates least-privilege policies for runtime, autoscaler, metrics, and logging with only required API actions documented
Supports provider switch variable (provider = "aws" | "gcp") and produces provider-appropriate resources
Automated unit tests (terratest) pass in CI for both AWS/GCP simulated runs
tfsec, checkov, and a schema/lint step pass in pre-commit, and policy diffs are visible in PRs
Upgrade path documented: v1 -> v2 policy diffs and how to apply non-breaking patches without downtime
Security review completed and signed off by Security and Compliance teams
